deviations: Contributions in the data are nominal; inflation-adjusted to 2018 dollars with CPI-U annual averages (2013: 232.957, 2018: 251.107). The paper does not state the base year or deflator.

Window-to-file mapping: SugarReplicate.dta = baseline window (verified as the superset window); SugarReplicate_iter1.dta assumed = calendar-year window and SugarReplicate_iter2.dta = 12-months-before window, following the order the windows are described in the text/Table 3. The data alone gave mixed evidence on this assignment.

Fixed-effects logit estimated as an unconditional logit with district (or incumbent) dummies on the vote-switching sample (the paper's table reports a constant and pseudo R2, as Stata logit with i.dummies does); robust (sandwich, n/(n-1)) SEs. A conditional logit gives roughly half-size coefficients (printed as a side check only).

The contribution regressor is the window-specific author-aggregated variable totalcont (differs across the three files); sugcont is identical across files and is taken to be the election-cycle aggregate, not used.
notes: Outcome y=1 if vote=='Aye', 0 otherwise (No, Not Voting, No Vote). District sample: districts with two rows whose y differs, complete covariates (94 switchers, 93 after one with missing data) -> 186 obs. Incumbent sample: those switching districts with both==1 (same member both votes) -> 53 incumbents (47 aye->not-aye, 6 no->aye), 106 obs; FE = incumbent (equivalently the district within this sample). Controls: ACU (ncu), tenure, poverty, bach, medincome, over65, agcom. agcom is quasi-separated (large coefficient, undefined SE) as in the paper; the reported quantities are unaffected. Attempts 1-3 were exploratory (data structure, file/window mapping, sample counts) and printed no RESULT lines. The Replication Read Me.docx (data documentation in the mount) was read; no script or output files exist in the mount.
